analysis_name: H3 domestic spike first-day activity breadth

assumptions.assumption: The first observed GA4 country is a usable proxy for domestic arrival.
assumptions.rationale: The cohort is defined by first-touch geo.country; location can reflect VPN or IP routing.
assumptions.validation_plan: Cross-check country against language and acquisition in a separate gate.

assumptions.assumption: The audited deliberate-event allowlist represents meaningful play across five areas.
assumptions.rationale: Reuses the definition from the prior 02 and 06 notebooks; auto and ledger events are excluded.
assumptions.validation_plan: Audit new game events against the allowlist and recalculate breadth.

assumptions.assumption: The GA4 export frozen through 2026-09-11 contains the relevant first-day events.
assumptions.rationale: Both target days precede the frozen end date; late arrivals may still move counts.
assumptions.validation_plan: Compare cohort sizes and numerators on rerun.

assumptions.assumption: Paid beta testers are not dominating the deeper-play tail.
assumptions.rationale: There is no stable tester flag in this GA4 extract; 3 and 4 devices reached all five areas.
assumptions.validation_plan: Obtain consented tester flags, check join coverage, and rerun sensitivity without testers.

assumptions.assumption: Distinct GA4 devices should not be interpreted as independent people.
assumptions.rationale: Cookie deletion and multiple devices may split one human across IDs.
assumptions.validation_plan: Keep conclusions descriptive until stable consented person-level identity exists.
